instruction: A wobbly tower of three thick pancakes topped with a melting pat of butter and a drizzle of syrup. Everything looks hand-molded from soft modeling clay, with visible fingerprint dimples, uneven edges, and a slightly squashed lean. Warm golden-brown clay surfaces meet glossy amber syrup and a pale yellow butter cube for a charmingly imperfect look.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE Claymation Pancake Stack in a claymation style. A wobbly tower of three thick pancakes topped with a melting pat of butter and a drizzle of syrup. Everything looks hand-molded from soft modeling clay, with visible fingerprint dimples, uneven edges, and a slightly squashed lean. Warm golden-brown clay surfaces meet glossy amber syrup and a pale yellow butter cube for a charmingly imperfect look. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
